thresholds.action: Immediate notification; patient acknowledgement due in 24 hours; clinical review in 48 hours.
Confirmatory venous fasting glucose / repeat HbA1c and clinical review within 14 days; specialist referral if confirmed.
Pre-diabetes lifestyle intervention and primary care follow-up within 30 days.

closure_checklist_json.name: Patient Result Acknowledgement
closure_checklist_json.description: Patient has confirmed receipt and passed teach-back verification.

closure_checklist_json.name: Confirmatory Test or Clinical Rationale
closure_checklist_json.description: Second confirmatory lab result logged or clinician documented rationale for proceeding without repeat.

closure_checklist_json.name: Specialist Referral Acceptance (If Applicable)
closure_checklist_json.description: Referral confirmed and accepted by receiving specialist without pending escrow.

closure_checklist_json.name: Specialist Consultation & Outcome Report
closure_checklist_json.description: Consultation summary, diagnosis confirmation, and long-term surveillance plan documented.

closure_checklist_json.name: Receiving Specialist Outcome Sign-Off
closure_checklist_json.description: Receiving clinician formal verification of completed care and discharge/management plan.

closure_checklist_json.name: Referring Primary Clinician Sign-Off
closure_checklist_json.description: Referring primary care provider final review and closure endorsement.

closure_checklist_json.name: Typed Case Disposition
closure_checklist_json.description: Documented formal disposition: CLINICALLY_RESOLVED, TRANSFERRED_CONFIRMED, DECLINED_AFTER_INFORMED_DISCUSSION, UNABLE_TO_CONTACT_AFTER_PROTOCOL, or OTHER_AUTHORISED.
